description:
Turn NCEA Level 3 results into a university rank score and a GPA.

    Use for: 'convert my NCEA to GPA', 'what is my rank score', 'what rank
    score do I need for engineering', 'NCEA entry score', 'preferential entry
    score', 'NCEA to 4.0 GPA'.

    ASK FOR THEIR RESULTS SUBJECT BY SUBJECT and pass `subjects`. The rank
    score is calculated by the universities that use one, not NZQA. The
    University of
    Auckland (rank score), Massey University (Preferential Entry Score, used
    when places are limited) and the University of Otago (entry score) publish
    the same method: the best 80 credits over at most five approved subjects,
    no more than 24 credits from any one subject, Excellence 4, Merit 3,
    Achieved 2, maximum 320. Totals alone cannot apply those limits, so a
    totals-only result is an UPPER BOUND (rank_score_is_upper_bound): say so.
    40 Excellence in one subject plus 20 Achieved in each of two other
    subjects is 240 as totals and 176 per subject. Do not say every
    university uses this. AUT counts the 80 best credits, at most 24 per
    subject, with no stated five-subject limit, so its score can be higher;
    the University of Canterbury does not use NCEA rank scores.

    ANSWER WITH THE RANK SCORE EVEN WHEN THEY ASKED FOR A GPA. The 4-point
    figure (Excellence 4, Merit 3, Achieved 2, Not Achieved 0, across every
    credit entered) is indicative and must be labelled unofficial. If they
    need an official figure for an overseas application, NZQA can provide its
    own grade point average estimate; tell them to ask NZQA.

    THE MOST USEFUL THING YOU CAN TELL THEM IS WHY CREDITS DID NOT COUNT:
    credits_over_subject_cap, credits_not_approved, credits_outside_best_five
    and credits_outside_best_80. Once 80 credits count, more Achieved credits
    are worth nothing and lifting existing credits to Merit is worth a great
    deal. next_step says which case they are in; lead with it.

    Args:
        subjects: PREFERRED. A list of {"name": "Calculus", "approved": true,
            "excellence_credits": 10, "merit_credits": 8,
            "achieved_credits": 2}, one per Level 3 subject. "approved" means
            on NZQA's approved list for University Entrance (default true).
            When given, the three totals below must be 0.
        excellence_credits: Level 3 Excellence credits as a total (upper
            bound only).
        merit_credits: Level 3 Merit credits as a total (upper bound only).
        achieved_credits: Level 3 Achieved credits as a total (upper bound
            only).
        not_achieved_credits: Credits attempted and not achieved, in total;
            lowers the GPA, never the rank score. Allowed with subjects.

    Returns:
        The rank score out of 320 with its working shown, which subjects and
        credits counted and why the rest did not, an unofficial 4-point GPA,
        and what would actually raise the score for this student.
name: nz_ncea_rank_score_calculator
